code_path_interpretation.reference_binding_behavior: When HeadCalc requests timestep reduction the solver publishes SW_SOLVE_RETRY_ADVISED and legacy-reference-retry; the accepted mass residual is deliberately not published.
code_path_interpretation.headcalc_behavior: HeadCalc independently requires both per-compartment balance convergence and abs(sum(residual)) <= total_balance_tolerance. If convergence is not reached it requests timestep reduction.
code_path_interpretation.production_default: The current fmr_b110_physical_parameters_t defaults both compartment_balance_tolerance and total_balance_tolerance to 1e-12 cm.
code_path_interpretation.observed_failure_class: Representative failures are driven by the total residual sum remaining slightly above 1e-12 cm after the iteration budget, often while every compartment residual and every head-change criterion is individually converged.
